content.short: Blueberry is a Hyperliquid DeFi terminal that tokenizes HLP vault yield into composable assets.
content.description: Blueberry turns yield from Hyperliquid's HLP vault into a token other protocols can use as collateral or trade, rather than a position locked inside one interface. Making a native yield source composable is usually what lets the rest of a chain's DeFi build on top of it.
content.meta: Turns Hyperliquid HLP vault yield into a token other protocols can price and accept as collateral.
